primary_claim: LLMs finetuned to predict properties of their own hypothetical behavior (M1) outperform a second model (M2) finetuned on the same ground-truth behavioral data at predicting M1's behavior on held-out tasks (e.g. Llama-3-70B self-prediction beats GPT-4o cross-prediction by +17% accuracy, p<0.01 across model pairs), remain better calibrated, and continue to predict their own behavior accurately even after that behavior is intentionally changed via further finetuning; however, this introspective capability does not generalize to complex tasks or out-of-distribution generalization.

effect.metric: self-prediction accuracy advantage of M1 over cross-predicting M2 on held-out tasks
effect.value: +17% accuracy advantage for Llama-3-70B (M1) over GPT-4o (M2) predicting Llama-3-70B's behavior; self-prediction accuracy exceeds cross-prediction for all model pairs tested (p<0.01)

contradicts_or_qualifies: Challenges the view that LLMs simply imitate their training distributions; the authors test and reject various alternative non-introspective explanations for the self-prediction advantage
stated_future_work: Investigate the self-simulation hypothesis about the mechanism underlying introspection in open-weight models such as Llama 70B
Explore the limits of introspective ability in more complex scenarios
Investigate potential applications for AI transparency alongside potential risks from introspective models
limitations_stated: Introspection is successfully elicited on simple tasks but not on more complex tasks or those requiring out-of-distribution generalization
Models struggle to predict their own behavior on tasks requiring reasoning over long outputs, such as writing a story
Models trained to introspect fail to generalize better to related tasks, e.g. self-awareness or coordinating with copies of the same LLM
M2 was not given access to M1's entire training data; the authors assume access to examples of M1's behavior is roughly equivalent for the task
quote: when M1 is Llama-3-70B and M2 is GPT-4o, the accuracy advantage of M1 over M2 is +17%.
